headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.30
summary: This release fixes the crash that happened when opening the CurseForge screen — the sort control was inflated as a TextView while the activity expected a MaterialButton, so tapping the CurseForge entry killed the launcher instantly. Everything else is unchanged.

items.text: Opening the CurseForge screen no longer crashes: the sort control in the toolbar is now typed as the TextView it actually is in the layout, instead of being cast to a MaterialButton and throwing a ClassCastException on every launch.
